_about: The prop kit for Ride UK (OSM stage 2): the models World/TorqueRideWorld draws by the road in place of their code-made shapes, by the kinds of World/WorldRideProps.cpp (RidePlan::EProp, PropName). Tools/ue_build_rideuk.py (prop_kit) imports Data/RideUK/Props/*.glb (Tools/make_ride_props.py: SM_Prop_<kind>_<n>), then looks for static meshes anywhere under /Game whose path holds one of a kind's 'words' (case, spaces and underscores ignored; Fab packs beenster has added and the hub has imported), preferring those, and lists them on a TorqueFoliage actor tagged RideProps, each scaled to the kind's 'height' in life (m). 'turn' (degrees) and 'drop' (m) put a model's front to +x and its foot on the ground. 'reach' is how far off it shows (m), 'shadow' whether it casts one. 'real_words' are scans of real, named places (a post box from Gravesend, a milestone on Clapham Common): used only when 'use_real_scans' is true (beenster's open question, streaming plan). 'credit' is shown on the credits page: CC BY assets need it. A kind with no model found keeps its code-made shape. No brands: check every model's textures before adding its words here.
